scope: Actual component JSX compiled and rendered in Chromium with React StrictMode, synthetic props and callback transport; not active-panel, database or provider E2E

before.failure: Same-tick duplicate submit left RELOAD_REQUIRED_OR_BUSY alert after the single mutation succeeded

patch: Submit handler checks controller.phase synchronously before submitting; remaining component unchanged
passedScenarios: StrictMode opens dialog and default feature remains disabled
Only active owned target sites are selectable
Wrong hostname or unloaded target blocks submission
Valid confirmation sends exact RPC fields without claiming routing verified
Pending blocks close, cancel and repeated submission
Failed response requests reread without automatic replay
Same-tick double submit sends once and leaves no false success error
Source change clears confirmation and ignores the old response
limits: No authenticated Supabase session or real database call
No full application build or device-matrix verification
